title: TRACE-Fib
question: How do normalization and study weighting affect cross-organ transfer?
methods: Frozen open-data inputs, study-aware evaluation and sensitivity analysis.
boundary: A bounded retrospective reanalysis; nominal source units are not independently verified people.

title: Beyond Macro-F1
question: Does better classification imply better calibration and perturbation consistency?
methods: Sanitized benchmark code, result provenance and versioned evidence.
boundary: A benchmark comparison does not establish clinical utility.

title: Selective skin-lesion referral
question: How do calibration and abstention change model evaluation?
methods: Lesion-level splitting, temperature scaling, risk–coverage analysis and subgroup audits.
boundary: Related-domain checks do not constitute prospective clinical validation.

title: ARDS / AHRF temporal validation
question: How does model performance change across time and ICU databases?
methods: Time-indexed EHR modelling, site shift, calibration and missingness audits.
boundary: Research software; patient-level inputs stay in the authorized environment.

title: Reading dynamics with ZuCo 2.0
question: Can lexical and early-fixation features predict later processing load?
methods: An installable package for HDF5 extraction, grouped evaluation and reproducible configurations.
boundary: Grouped benchmark performance does not establish a general cognitive mechanism.

title: Respiratory surveillance
question: Can aggregate surveillance signals anticipate next-week escalation?
methods: Rolling-origin validation, chronological holdout and state-cluster uncertainty.
boundary: A later holdout within one surveillance ecosystem is not external validation.

title: Temporal screening evaluation
question: Does model complexity improve probability estimation under temporal shift?
methods: Survey-weighted evaluation, calibration and a prespecified complexity-value gate.
boundary: The complexity-value gate failed; one HbA1c measurement is not confirmed diabetes.

title: Extubation transportability
question: How does endpoint construction affect cross-database transport?
methods: Endpoint reconstruction, source-only transport and calibration diagnostics.
boundary: Endpoint repair and external validation do not establish clinical readiness.

title: Dynamic AKI prediction
question: How do temporal renal models behave under external transport?
methods: Dynamic prediction, alert thresholds and deployment constraints.
boundary: Discrimination, calibration and patient benefit are distinct questions.

title: Cross-corpus abstract classification
question: How do lightweight sentence classifiers transfer between corpora?
methods: Split-aware preprocessing, calibration and cross-corpus evaluation.
boundary: Read version-specific evidence; the local revision can be newer than the public release.

title: Sleep-EDF staging
question: How do local context, channel choice and smoothing affect sleep staging?
methods: Record-aware evaluation, channel ablations and repeated-seed comparisons.
boundary: Sequence smoothing can trade off different metrics; preserve record boundaries.

title: Rationale reliability audit
question: Do supporting rationales remain faithful and robust?
methods: Rationale evaluation, calibration, functional checks and subgroup diagnostics.
boundary: Benchmark audits do not certify fairness or suitability for automated moderation.

title: SAFE-LABS
question: How can a selective-prediction policy be tested without overstating safety?
methods: Protocol, synthetic fixtures and exploratory empirical adapters.
boundary: Empirical outputs remain outside the public release pending named disclosure review.
